candidates.hook: A thug lunges roaring 'Aaargh!', but Alexander effortlessly catches the swinging club barehanded mid-air.
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander hoists the choking thug up the stone wall and roars 'Who?!', cutting right before the mastermind is named.
candidates.why: Showcases the ultimate power fantasy of the underestimated broken soldier protecting his wife, cutting on an explosive interrogation cliffhanger.

candidates.hook: Alexander yanks a thug off the ground by his coat collar against the stone wall, demanding 'Who sent you?'
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana questions Alexander's suspiciously lethal combat skills as she reaches toward his bleeding hand under the moonlight.
candidates.why: Unmasks the villain's conspiracy while pivoting into the show's core romantic mystery regarding the broken soldier's true identity.
candidates.context_needed: Gerald Harrington is Juliana's malicious rival who hired thugs to ruin her garden.

moments.desc: Alexander orders Juliana to stay behind him, catches an iron club barehanded, and slams the attacker into the mud.
Alexander chokes the thug against the wall until he confesses that Gerald Harrington paid them, leaving Juliana heartbroken.
Juliana marvels at Alexander's combat reflexes, prompting him to darkly confess that a soldier learns things he wishes he could forget.
